usageNotes: Returns a list of hardware category types (e.g. 'pci', 'usb') available for inspection on the specified node — use this as a discovery step before querying a specific hardware subcategory. The node must be online and reachable by the cluster; the endpoint is accessible to all authenticated users with no privilege restrictions. No query parameters exist; the only input is the node name.

examples.summary: List available hardware categories on node 'pve1'

tips: The response is a navigation index — each returned 'type' value corresponds to a child endpoint under /nodes/{node}/hardware/{type} (e.g. /nodes/pve1/hardware/pci).
Typical types include 'pci' and 'usb'; the exact list depends on what the Proxmox version exposes for the node.
This endpoint is safe to poll frequently; it is read-only and carries no performance impact.
